headline: Vietnam proposes ending the death penalty for six offences, keeping it for only four crimes

words.def_en: A punishment given for breaking a law.
words.example_en: Vietnam's government has proposed to abolish the death penalty for six offences, including drug trafficking.
Each offence on the new list would no longer carry a death sentence.
